examples.title: Spawning and running a command
examples.explanation: The exec.Command function creates a Command struct configured to run the specified binary with arguments, and Run starts the command and waits for it to complete.

examples.title: Waiting for process completion
examples.explanation: Using Start launches the process asynchronously, and calling Wait blocks the parent execution until the child process finishes.

examples.title: Handling missing commands gracefully
examples.explanation: If the binary cannot be found, Run returns an error that can be checked and printed without terminating the main shell application.
